chapter.verse: Tua ahih ciangin Khazih sungah hansuahna ahi zongin, itna tawh kipawl lungnopna ahi zongin, Kha Siangtho tawh kihotheihna ahi zongin, hehpihna leh diksakna ahi zongin na khatpeuh peuh a om leh, khat leh khat ki-it ciatin, khat leh khat lungsim kikhen loin hanciamna kibangin, lungsim kikhatin na om manunah ka lungdamna na cingsak un.
Huaihamna lungsim, a mawkna minthan’ deihna lungsim neihna tawh bangmah na hih kei un. Midangte in note sangin a phazaw hi ci-in lungsim niamkhiatna tawh khat leh khat na kingaihsun un.
Nomau noptuamna bek ngaihsun loin, midangte’ noptuam nadingin khat leh khat na kingaihsun un.
Khazih Zeisu sungah a om lungsim note sungah om ta hen:
Amah in Pasian’ lim leh meel tawh dimin a om napi-in, Pasian tawh kibatnate ka khah kei ding hi ci loin,
Ama minthan’na paai-in, sila lim la-in, Mi tawh kibatna-ah a suak hi.
Tua bang lim tawh dimin kimu a, Sihna a thuak tham loin, singlamteh tungah a sih dongin, Thumang-in ama pumpi a kiniamsak hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Pasian in amah pahtawi-in Min khempeuhte sangin min a lianzaw a pia hi.

Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Vantung, leitung, leinuai-a om mi khempeuh in, Zeisu’ min hangin khukdin’ uh a, “Pa Pasian’ minthan’na kilatsak nadingin, ‘Zeisu Khazih in Topa ahi hi,’ ci-in, Leii khempeuh in a mang ding uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin ka itte aw, note in thu na man’ tawntung uh bangin keimah maitangah tham loin, ka muh lohna-ah zong thungai-in, launa liin’na lungsim tawh, gupna na ngahna uh semkhia un.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, note in ama deihna bangin na sepnop nading uh leh na sep theih nadingun Pasian mahmah in nomau sungah hong sem ding hi.
Note in na hihna khempeuh uh ah thuum lo, tau lo, kinial loin na hih un.

Tua bangin na hih uh leh, mawhsak nading om loin, kuama tungah khialhna om loin, lungkawi-a kisia mi pawlte lakah mawhna neu kha beek a nei lo Pasian’ tate na suak ding uh hi. Nuntakna tawh kipawl thu hilhin, vantunga aksite bangin tua mi pawlte lakah na taang ding uh hi.
Tua ahih leh, kei in a mawkna-in tai ka hi kei a, a mawkna-in nasemin hahkat ka hi kei hi ci-in Khazih’ Ni ciangin lungdam kisathei-in ka om ding hi.
Tua tham loin, na piak uh biakna, note upna biakna tungah ka pumpi ka piakhia zongin, ka nuam hi; note khempeuh tawh ka lungdam khawm hi.
Tua mah bangin note in zong nuam un la, keimah tawh lungdam khawm un.
Ahih hangin note thu thei-in ka lungnop tuam nadingin, note kiangah Timoti ka hong sawl ding hi ci-in Zeisu sungah ka lamen hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, amah in note phattuam nading lungsim pha a neih bangin a nei khat beek keima kiangah a om kei hi.
Amaute in Zeisu Khazih’ phattuamna zong loin amaute’ phattuamna bek a zong uh hi.
Ahih hangin ta in a pa tawh na a sepkhawm mah bangin Timoti in kei tawh Lungdamna Thu khan’sakna-ah na a semkhawm hi ci-in ama teci thu note in na thei uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin keima tungah bang thu a piang ka theih khit ciangin, amah note kiangah amanlangin kong sawl ding hi ci-in lamenin ka om hi.
Ahih hangin keimahmah zong note kiangah a sawt loin ka hong pai ding hi, ci-in Topa sungah ka um hi.
Ahih hangin nasepna leh galdona ah keimah hong vaak, hong khoi mi ahi, note sawltak ahi, ka naupa Epafroditas, note kiangah tu-in ka hong sawl ding kilawm ka sa hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, a ci natna thu note in na zak uh bangin, amah in note hong ngai-in, nakpi lungzuangin a om hi.
Amah in si dek takin a gim mahmah hi. Ahih hangin Pasian in amah a hehpih hi. Amah bek ahi kei hi, keima dahna a kibehlap sawnsawn loh nadingin kei zong hong hehpih hi.
Tua ahih ciangin note in amah na muhkik uh ciangin na lungdam nading uh ahi zongin, keima dahna zong a kiam nading ahi zongin nomau kiangah hahkatin ka hong sawl hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Topa sungah lungdamna tawh amah na tungsak un la, tua bang mite na zahtak un.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, note in kei nong vaak, nong khoina uh a kicing lote amah in kicingsak dingin Khazih adingin ama nuntakna a sih dektak zah dongin a hanciam zo hi.
